scope: Read-only final source review of Vault Shared click commits 261393fd and fa346b73, and guest SEO restricted-page recovery commit 702ba1db. No implementation edit, browser run, build, mock, or clipboard operation.

A_acceptance.evidence: Run 005 reached settled Mine inventory with zero designated candidates and a Shared tab, then stopped at shared_tab_click. The receipt has no pointer diagnostic or exact click failure mechanism. No post-repair owned-profile run was reviewed.
A_acceptance.remaining: A root-guarded run must observe the trusted Shared click, active Shared scope in the linked Vault panel, and settled masked Shared inventory. Member authentication remains outside this probe.

evidence: The new click kind requires exactly one active Vault role tab, follows its nonempty aria-controls to a panel that itself has active role tabpanel state, and searches only that panel for a Shared (integer count) role tab.

The shared driver requires one visible candidate, scrolls it into view, clips candidate points to ancestor overflow, checks elementFromPoint, waits for stable non-animating hit samples, rejects disabled targets, and sends CDP mousePressed and mouseReleased events. It does not call DOM click().

The probe waits for the linked Vault panel to expose active Shared scope with inventory and refresh spinners clear before reading candidate counts. Its page-realm summary exports fixed booleans and counts, not Vault item content.
limits: The probe's inventory observer still reads the first document Vault trigger, while the new click kind rejects multiple active Vault triggers. This does not weaken click targeting, but a future duplicate trigger could leave observation and click behavior asymmetric.
The run 005 failure mechanism is unknown; selector hardening is not proven to fix that particular failure until a real rerun.

A_acceptance.evidence: Commit 702ba1db prepared a real about:blank navigation and public-page recovery path, but its preparation report states that no browser acceptance run occurred.
A_acceptance.remaining: Run the owned native sidepanel batch and inspect the T03 negative and recovery observations.

evidence: The test navigates the owned tab to actual about:blank and confirms its URL. It requires the selected, linked SEO panel to show the exact restricted-page error, omit the Title & description group and Copy audit button, and offer an enabled Audit this page button.

The same owned tab returns to a real public page. The test compares the visible audit title and headings presence with that page's inspected DOM, requires enabled Re-audit, and checks the error is gone. No interception, mock response, or clipboard action was added.
The report keeps unreachable HTTP(S), other restricted schemes, and the restricted reload dimension deferred; overall batch status is partial only after all asserted targets pass.
limits: Recovery revisits the first public page, which was audited earlier in the batch. The visible title/heading oracle does not independently prove a new capture occurred after recovery.

The stale-content check is confined to the SEO pane's title group and Copy audit button; it does not explicitly assert the absence of every audit detail or a globally portaled copy menu. Current SeoView source clears audit on capture failure, so this is an oracle coverage limit rather than an observed product defect.
The restricted message names the limitation and the enabled button offers retry; retry on about:blank itself cannot succeed. The batch does not test user guidance to navigate to an auditable page.
